quotes.title: K2-33
quotes.card: K2-33 is an extremely young pre-main-sequence star located about 453 light-years (139 pc) away from the Earth in the constellation of Scorpius.
quotes.introduction: It is known to host one planet, a super-Neptune, named K2-33b.
